topic: IELTS Writing Task 1: the chart is about

vars.basic: I always start my report with: The chart is about phone sales.
vars.rule: For Task 1, start with The chart illustrates, then say what and when.
vars.better: Perfect: The chart illustrates phone sales in three countries over ten years.
vars.tip: shows and compares work too. Just don't copy the question word for word.
